# Greg Mitchell

> Greg Mitchell is a digital analytics and technical solutions leader in Longmont, Colorado, with 14 years across automotive, agencies, and enterprise data platforms. He implements website tags in Google Tag Manager, Tealium, and Ensighten, and works with client data layers from discovery through implementation and ongoing maintenance. He led a 13-person analytics and data engineering team and managed pixel implementation for a measurement product across 20 automotive clients. Open to remote roles.

## Summary

Digital analytics and technical solutions leader with 14 years of experience across automotive, agencies, and enterprise data platforms. Hands-on experience implementing website tags using Google Tag Manager (GTM), Tealium, and Ensighten. Worked with client data layers from initial discovery through implementation and ongoing maintenance. Led a 13-person analytics and data engineering team and managed pixel implementation for a measurement product across 20 automotive clients.

## Core competencies

Google Tag Manager (GTM); Tealium and Ensighten; website tags and data layers; Google Analytics 4 (GA4); tracking pixels; tagging QA and troubleshooting; measurement and attribution; data quality and validation; SQL and Python; AWS and data engineering; vendor and client management; cross-functional leadership.

## Experience

- **Director, New Initiatives, Path2Response (2023–2026).** Led data and technology partnerships, integration requirements, and technical implementation support for a first-party data and direct-mail co-op. Installed tracking tags in clients' Google Tag Manager containers, supporting 300+ active tags across e-commerce sites. Built an internal pixel-monitoring tool and troubleshot tagging and measurement issues with client teams. Implemented GA4 through Google Tag Manager and helped the marketing team build GA4 reporting. Managed eight external data and technology partner relationships; partner-sourced data volume nearly doubled over two years. Guided first-party audience integration into LiveRamp, reaching 50+ DSPs and audience platforms. Produced monthly and quarterly reports for the executive committee on tagging and licensed data product activity. Reduced client onboarding from more than seven days to one business day.

- **Associate Director of Analytics, Spark Foundry (2021–2023).** Led a 13-person remote analytics and data engineering team supporting a large pharmaceutical client, responsible for measurement, reporting infrastructure, and data platforms. Senior client and stakeholder lead across media, analytics, engineering, and executive teams. Led the migration of legacy reporting systems to AWS. Established repeatable onboarding, delivery, documentation, and QA processes. Four direct reports earned AWS certifications.

- **Solutions Engineering Manager, Aqfer (2020–2021).** Established the client-facing solutions function for an enterprise data platform serving advertising and marketing measurement. Led technical discovery and solution design for 12 enterprise clients, including Acxiom, U.S. Bank, MLB, and Vevo. Client-facing technical lead for requirements, scoping, demonstrations, and implementation. Designed client-specific data integration workflows with engineering. Established issue tracking, delivery documentation, and QA standards.

- **Data Operations Engineer, Goodway Group (2018–2020).** Built and maintained ETL pipelines that brought advertising and third-party data into a central analytics environment. Improved website tagging, tracking pixels, data collection, and measurement troubleshooting with clients. Configured and troubleshot Google Analytics event tracking. Produced campaign analytics, reporting, and data quality improvements with SQL, Python, and Tableau.

- **Lead Data Analyst and Solutions Manager, J.D. Power (Korrelate, acquired 2014) (2011–2018).** Managed digital measurement and attribution programs for 20 automotive clients, including manufacturers and dealer groups. Led a team that deployed tracking tags across client websites, assessing each environment and its tag management tools (GTM, Tealium, Ensighten) and data layers. Translated campaign and business goals into reporting requirements. Delivered online-to-offline attribution by matching website pixel data to vehicle purchase records in an early privacy-safe data environment. Produced campaign measurement, attribution analysis, and executive reporting for OEM, Tier 2, and automotive endemic clients. Standardized measurement reporting and delivery processes.
